question: What attainment makes a practitioner beloved by the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
Such great accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
Possessing this accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginis
inference: A practitioner who attains the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
